title: papaver nudicaule var. kamtschaticum
intro: Papaver nudicaule var. kamtschaticum, commonly known as Kamchatka poppy or Yellow Poppy, is a plant species belonging to the poppy family (Papaveraceae). It is known for its potential health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation, alleviate pain, and soothe digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Kamchatka poppy include acting as an anti-inflammatory, analgesic, and antispasmodic agent. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
